title: Hook Input Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for normalized lifecycle hook inputs delivered via stdin to developer hook scripts.

event.description: Lifecycle phase of the hook invocation.

tool.description: Canonical tool category (e.g. shell, read, write, edit, search, delegate) or custom tool identifier.

subagent.description: Subagent type or name identifier (e.g. for SubagentStop or delegation events).

args.description: Normalized dictionary of parameters supplied to the tool or subagent. On SubagentStop it may also carry `fully_idle` (boolean: no work of this agent's own is outstanding), `fully_idle_source` (`harness` when the harness reported it, `ledger` when derived from the agent's recorded background launches and the harness's live-task list) and, when not idle, `outstanding_work` (the live tasks, each with `task_id`, `task_type` and `launched_at`).

output.description: Execution output, deliverable, or result payload (populated for PostToolUse and SubagentStop events).

success.description: Whether tool execution completed successfully without error (populated for PostToolUse events).

workspace.description: Absolute filesystem path to the active workspace root.

package.description: Canonical identifier of the TPU agent suite package owning the hook.

session_id.description: Unique session or conversation identifier from the host harness.

run_id.description: Active TPU agent suite run identifier for the current session.

harness.description: Name of the harness the event came from (tool and termination events).

raw_input.description: Unmodified original input payload received from the host harness (for diagnostics or unmapped parameters).

termination.description: Present for Stop. Why the loop ended, and how many times it has already been resumed.

reason.description: Harness termination reason, verbatim. Only the Google harnesses report one, drawn from Antigravity's TERMINATION_REASON_* enum, e.g. 'NO_TOOL_CALL', 'USER_CANCELED', 'ERROR'.

error.description: Error text when the loop ended in failure; empty otherwise.

execution_num.description: How many executions this conversation has had. 1 on the first stop.

fully_idle.description: True when no background work is outstanding; null when the harness did not say.
